## Download the source workbook

```{r download-data}
# Download the workbook from GitHub.
# The source folder is 2-Data/Raw/.
github_base <- paste0(
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pr1nc3sso/",
  "Xilei-Living-cover-crop/master/2-Data/Raw/"
)

file_url <- paste0(
  github_base,
  "Broccoli%20harvest.xlsx"
)

file_path <- tempfile(fileext = ".xlsx")

options(timeout = max(120, getOption("timeout", 60)))

status <- download.file(
  file_url,
  file_path,
  mode = "wb",
  method = "libcurl",
  quiet = TRUE
)

if (status != 0L) {
  stop("GitHub download failed. Check the URL.")
}

output_dir <- file.path(
  getwd(),
  "Yield_results"
)

dir.create(
  output_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

```

## Read living-mulch records

```{r living-read}
# Read the first nine columns.
raw <- read_excel(
  file_path,
  sheet = "living mulch",
  range = cell_cols("A:I"),
  col_types = "text"
)

names(raw) <- c(
  "harvest_date",
  "block",
  "treatment",
  "row_position",
  "fresh_weight_g",
  "grade",
  "appearance_note",
  "hollow_core",
  "marketable"
)

raw$excel_row <- seq_len(nrow(raw)) + 1L

knitr::kable(
  data.frame(
    Sheet = "living mulch",
    Imported_rows = nrow(raw)
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

## Clean living-mulch records

```{r living-clean}
dat <- raw %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      c(block, treatment, row_position, marketable),
      ~ na_if(toupper(trimws(.x)), "")
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    if_any(
      c(block, treatment, row_position, fresh_weight_g),
      ~ !is.na(.x)
    )
  )

if (anyNA(dat[c("block", "treatment", "row_position")])) {
  stop("Missing identifiers. Check the source workbook.")
}

valid_rows <- c(
  "E", "EAST",
  "M", "MIDDLE", "CENTER", "CENTRE",
  "W", "WEST"
)

if (
  any(!dat$treatment %in% c("T1", "T2", "T3", "T4")) ||
  any(!dat$row_position %in% valid_rows)
) {
  stop("Unexpected treatment or row labels.")
}

living_clean <- dat

knitr::kable(
  living_clean %>%
    count(treatment, row_position, name = "Heads"),
  caption = "Living-mulch records before middle-row selection"
)
```

## Select living-mulch middle-row heads

```{r living-select}
# Only middle-row heads enter the yield analysis.
dat <- living_clean %>%
  filter(
    treatment %in% c("T2", "T3", "T4"),
    row_position %in% c(
      "M", "MIDDLE", "CENTER", "CENTRE"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    fresh_weight_g = as.numeric(fresh_weight_g)
  )

if (
  nrow(dat) == 0L ||
  anyNA(dat$fresh_weight_g) ||
  any(!is.finite(dat$fresh_weight_g)) ||
  any(dat$fresh_weight_g <= 0)
) {
  stop("Missing or invalid middle-row head weights.")
}

if (any(!dat$block %in% paste0("B", 1:4))) {
  stop("Unexpected block labels.")
}

dat <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    block = factor(
      block,
      levels = paste0("B", 1:4)
    ),
    treatment = factor(
      treatment,
 levels = c("T2", "T3", "T4")
    )
  )

if (any(table(dat$block, dat$treatment) == 0L)) {
  stop("A plot has no harvest records; do not assume zero yield.")
}

```

## Marketable heads in the middle strip
```{r living-marketability-check}
marketable_head <- function(grade, flag) {
  trimws(as.character(grade)) %in% c("3", "4", "5") &
    toupper(trimws(flag)) %in% "Y"
}

living_heads <- dat %>%
  mutate(in_yield = marketable_head(grade, marketable))

knitr::kable(
  living_heads %>%
    group_by(treatment) %>%
    summarise(weighed = n(), marketable = sum(in_yield), .groups = "drop"),
  caption = "Middle-strip head counts by treatment"
)
```

## Check the living-mulch harvest area

```{r living-area}
plot_length_m <- 4.0
plot_width_m <- 6.7
plot_area_m2 <- plot_length_m * plot_width_m
living_strip_area_m2 <- plot_area_m2 / 3
plastic_section_area_m2 <- 2 * plot_area_m2 / 3

knitr::kable(
  data.frame(
    Area = c(
      "Whole experimental plot",
      "Harvested middle band"
    ),
    Area_m2 = c(
      plot_area_m2,
    living_strip_area_m2
    )
  ),
  digits = 3,
  row.names = FALSE,
  caption = "Living-mulch area used in the calculation"
)
```

## Calculate living-mulch yield

```{r living-yield}
plot_data <- living_heads %>%
group_by(block, treatment) %>%
summarise(
yield_kg = sum(fresh_weight_g[in_yield]) / 1000,
heads = sum(in_yield),
.groups = "drop"
) %>%
mutate(
mean_head_g = if_else(heads > 0, yield_kg * 1000 / heads, NA_real_),
harvest_area_m2 = living_strip_area_m2,
yield_kg_ha = yield_kg / harvest_area_m2 * 10000
)

stopifnot(nrow(plot_data) == 12L)

knitr::kable(
  plot_data,
  digits = 3,
  row.names = FALSE,
  col.names = c(
    "Block", "Treatment", "kg", "Heads",
"g/head", "Area (m2)", "kg/ha"
  ),
caption = "Marketable head mass, head count, mean head weight and yield by plot"
)
```

## Fit the living-mulch yield model

```{r yield-model}
# Fit the model using yield per unit area.
fit <- lm(
yield_kg_ha ~ treatment + block,
  data = plot_data
)

anova_result <- anova(fit)

# Adjusted treatment means and Tukey comparisons.
emm <- emmeans(
  fit,
  ~ treatment,
  weights = "equal"
)

emm_table <- as.data.frame(
  confint(
    emm,
    level = 0.95
  )
)

tukey_table <- as.data.frame(
  summary(
    pairs(emm, adjust = "tukey"),
    infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)
  )
)

# Confirmed mowing times relative to broccoli transplanting:
# T2: 1 week before, and 3 and 6 weeks after transplanting.
# T3: 1 week before, and 6 weeks after transplanting.
# T4: 1 week before transplanting only.
#
# Negative weeks indicate time before transplanting.
# Positive weeks indicate time after transplanting.
treatment_labels <- c(
  T4 = "T4\n-1 week",
  T3 = "T3\n-1 and +6 weeks",
  T2 = "T2\n-1, +3 and +6 weeks"
)
```

## Mowing schedule

All three treatments were mown one week before broccoli transplanting.
Additional mowing followed the treatment-specific schedule:

- **T2:** mown at 3 and 6 weeks after transplanting,
  giving three mowing events in total.
- **T3:** mown at 6 weeks after transplanting,
  giving two mowing events in total.
- **T4:** no additional mowing after transplanting,
  giving one mowing event in total.

The analysis compares these three treatment categories.
Mowing times and the number of mowing events are not entered
as continuous predictors.

## Response and experimental unit

Each 4.0 m by 6.7 m living-mulch plot contained three planting strips.
The middle strip represented `r sprintf("%.2f", living_strip_area_m2)` square
metres including interspaces. Marketable fresh mass from all harvests was
summed within each plot and converted to kg/ha. Mean marketable head
weight is expressed in grams per head.

The yield model compared T2, T3 and T4 across four randomized blocks.
The adjacent plastic-mulched beds provided a descriptive reference.
Two beds with four sections each represented
`r sprintf("%.2f", 8 * plastic_section_area_m2)` square metres including
interspaces. Weather and equipment problems led to different transplanting
times in the two areas.
With one response per plot, the treatment-by-block interaction cannot be
estimated separately from residual error. The model assumes additive
treatment and block effects.

```{r plot-data}
plot_display <- data.frame(
  Block = plot_data$block,
  Treatment = plot_data$treatment,
  Heads = plot_data$heads,
  Harvest_area_m2 = sprintf(
    "%.2f",
    plot_data$harvest_area_m2
  ),
Yield_kg_ha = sprintf(
"%.2f",
plot_data$yield_kg_ha
  )
)

knitr::kable(
  plot_display,
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

## Analysis of variance

Treatment and block are fitted as fixed factors. The design is balanced,
with treatment, block and residual degrees of freedom of 2, 3 and 6.

```{r anova}
# Format display tables without rounding the analysis objects.
format_p <- function(x) {
  ifelse(
    is.na(x),
    "",
    ifelse(
      x < 0.001,
      "<0.001",
  sprintf("%.4f", x)
    )
  )
}

a <- as.data.frame(anova_result)

anova_display <- data.frame(
  Source = rownames(a),
  df = as.integer(a$Df),
  SS = sprintf("%.2f", a[["Sum Sq"]]),
  MS = sprintf("%.2f", a[["Mean Sq"]]),
  F = ifelse(
    is.na(a[["F value"]]),
    "",
    sprintf("%.2f", a[["F value"]])
  ),
  p = format_p(a[["Pr(>F)"]])
)

knitr::kable(
  anova_display,
  row.names = FALSE,
caption = "ANOVA of marketable broccoli yield (kg/ha)"
)
```

## Adjusted treatment means

Means are adjusted for block and expressed in kg/ha.
The table reports each estimated marginal mean, its model-based SE,
and its individual 95% confidence interval.
The figure shows means with error bars of one SE.

```{r adjusted-means}
emm_display <- data.frame(
  Treatment = emm_table$treatment,
  Mean = sprintf("%.2f", emm_table$emmean),
  SE = sprintf("%.2f", emm_table$SE),
  df = as.integer(emm_table$df),
  Lower = sprintf("%.2f", emm_table$lower.CL),
  Upper = sprintf("%.2f", emm_table$upper.CL)
)

knitr::kable(
  emm_display,
  row.names = FALSE,
caption = "Adjusted yield means, SEs and 95% CIs (kg/ha)"
)
```

## Tukey pairwise comparisons

All three pairwise treatment comparisons are of interest.
Tukey adjustment was therefore used to control the family-wise
Type I error rate across these comparisons. Comparisons are based
on estimated marginal means adjusted for block.

Differences, SEs and confidence limits are expressed in kg/ha.
The confidence intervals and p-values below are Tukey-adjusted.

```{r tukey}
tukey_display <- data.frame(
  Contrast = tukey_table$contrast,
  Difference = sprintf("%.2f", tukey_table$estimate),
  SE = sprintf("%.2f", tukey_table$SE),
  df = as.integer(tukey_table$df),
  Lower = sprintf("%.2f", tukey_table$lower.CL),
  Upper = sprintf("%.2f", tukey_table$upper.CL),
  p = format_p(tukey_table$p.value)
)

knitr::kable(
  tukey_display,
  row.names = FALSE,
  caption = "Pairwise yield differences with Tukey-adjusted 95% CIs"
)
```

## Plastic-mulch reference

### Check the plastic-mulch area

```{r plastic-area}
plastic_bed_area_m2 <- plastic_section_area_m2

knitr::kable(
  data.frame(
    Area = c(
      "One bed section",
      "Four sections, two beds each"
    ),
    Area_m2 = c(
      plastic_bed_area_m2,
      8 * plastic_bed_area_m2
    )
  ),
  digits = 3,
  row.names = FALSE,
  caption = "Plastic-mulch area used in the calculation"
)
```

### Read plastic-mulch records

```{r plastic-read}
plastic_raw <- read_excel(
  file_path,
  sheet = "plastic mulch",
  range = cell_cols("A:H"),
col_types = c("date", rep("text", 7))
)

names(plastic_raw) <- c(
  "harvest_date", "section", "row_position", "fresh_weight_g",
  "grade", "appearance_note", "hollow_core", "marketable"
)

knitr::kable(
  data.frame(
    Sheet = "plastic mulch",
    Imported_rows = nrow(plastic_raw)
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

### Clean plastic-mulch records

```{r plastic-clean}
plastic_dat <- plastic_raw %>%
  mutate(
across(where(is.character), ~ na_if(trimws(.x), ""))
  ) %>%
  filter(
    if_any(
      c(harvest_date, section, row_position, fresh_weight_g),
      ~ !is.na(.x)
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    row_position = toupper(row_position),
    row_position = recode(
      row_position,
      E = "EAST",
      W = "WEST"
    ),
    fresh_weight_g = as.numeric(fresh_weight_g)
  )

if (
  nrow(plastic_dat) == 0L ||
  anyNA(plastic_dat[c("section", "row_position", "fresh_weight_g")]) ||
  any(!plastic_dat$section %in% as.character(1:4)) ||
  any(!plastic_dat$row_position %in% c("EAST", "WEST")) ||
  any(!is.finite(plastic_dat$fresh_weight_g)) ||
  any(plastic_dat$fresh_weight_g <= 0)
) {
  stop("Check section, row and fresh-weight entries in the plastic mulch sheet.")
}

plastic_dat <- plastic_dat %>%
mutate(
harvest_date = as.Date(harvest_date),
marketable = toupper(marketable)
)

confirmed_head <- with(plastic_dat, which(
harvest_date == as.Date("2026-10-22") & section == "2" &
row_position == "WEST" & fresh_weight_g == 241 & grade == "3"
))
stopifnot(length(confirmed_head) <= 1L)
if (length(confirmed_head) == 1L && is.na(plastic_dat$marketable[confirmed_head])) {
plastic_dat$marketable[confirmed_head] <- "Y"
}

plastic_heads <- plastic_dat %>%
mutate(in_yield = marketable_head(grade, marketable))

knitr::kable(
plastic_heads %>%
summarise(weighed = n(), marketable = sum(in_yield)),
caption = "Plastic-mulch head counts"
)
```

### Calculate plastic-mulch yield

```{r plastic-yield}
plastic_bed_data <- plastic_heads %>%
group_by(section, row_position) %>%
summarise(
heads = sum(in_yield),
yield_kg = sum(fresh_weight_g[in_yield]) / 1000,
.groups = "drop"
) %>%
mutate(
mean_head_g = if_else(heads > 0, yield_kg * 1000 / heads, NA_real_),
harvest_area_m2 = plastic_bed_area_m2,
yield_kg_ha = yield_kg / harvest_area_m2 * 10000
)

if (
  nrow(plastic_bed_data) != 8L ||
  !all(
    table(
      plastic_bed_data$section,
      plastic_bed_data$row_position
    ) == 1L
  )
) {
  stop("Expected East and West records for each of the four plastic sections.")
}

knitr::kable(
  plastic_bed_data,
  digits = 3,
  row.names = FALSE,
caption = "Marketable yield and mean head weight by bed section"
)
```

### Pool the plastic-mulch reference

```{r plastic-reference}
# One pooled descriptive reference; not an additional model treatment.
plastic_reference <- plastic_bed_data %>%
  summarise(
    bed_sections = n(),
    heads = sum(heads),
    total_yield_kg = sum(yield_kg),
    total_area_m2 = sum(harvest_area_m2)
  ) %>%
mutate(
mean_head_g = if_else(heads > 0, total_yield_kg * 1000 / heads, NA_real_),
yield_kg_ha = total_yield_kg / total_area_m2 * 10000
)

plastic_ref_kg_ha <- plastic_reference$yield_kg_ha

write.csv(
  plastic_bed_data,
  file.path(output_dir, "Plastic_mulch_bed_yield.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  plastic_reference,
  file.path(output_dir, "Plastic_mulch_reference.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

knitr::kable(
  plastic_reference,
  digits = 3,
  row.names = FALSE,
caption = "Pooled marketable yield and mean head weight under plastic mulch"
)
```

## Yield figure

Negative weeks indicate mowing before transplanting.
Positive weeks indicate mowing after transplanting.

```{r yield-figure}

p <- ggplot(
  plot_data,
aes(x = treatment, y = yield_kg_ha)
) +
  geom_hline(
yintercept = plastic_ref_kg_ha,
    linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "#346B87",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(shape = block),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.4),
    size = 2.5
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    data = emm_table,
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    aes(
      x = treatment,
      ymin = emmean - SE,
      ymax = emmean + SE
    ),
    width = 0.12,
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = emm_table,
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    aes(x = treatment, y = emmean),
    shape = 18,
    size = 4
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = treatment_labels) +
  expand_limits(y = 0) +
  labs(
subtitle = sprintf("Plastic-mulch reference: %s kg/ha",
                   formatC(plastic_ref_kg_ha, format = "f", digits = 0,
                           big.mark = ",")),
x = "Mowing weeks relative to transplanting",
y = "Marketable broccoli yield (kg/ha)",
shape = "Block",
caption = paste(
  "Points show plot yields. Diamonds and bars show adjusted means and one SE.",
  "The dashed line shows the pooled yield from the two plastic-mulched beds.",
  sep = "\n"
)
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 8)
  )

print(p)
```
## Model diagnostics

Inspect residual spread and the normal Q-Q plot before interpreting the
tests. A non-significant Shapiro-Wilk test does not prove normality.

```{r diagnostics, fig.height=3.5}
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))

plot(fit, which = 1)
plot(fit, which = 2)

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

shapiro.test(residuals(fit))
```

# Locate the local project root.
project_root <- normalizePath(
  getwd(),
  winslash = "/",

)

repeat {
  required_folders <- file.path(
    project_root,
    c("2-Data", "5-Analysis")

  parent_dir <- dirname(project_root)

  if (identical(parent_dir, project_root)) {

}

capture.output(
